parameters.name: abcode
parameters.meaning: Abend code to issue, no greater than 4095

parameters.name: clean-up
parameters.meaning: 0 abends without clean-up; 1 to 5 abend with enclave termination processing and the documented CEEDUMP/system dump variations; illegal values abend without clean-up

semantics.control: No return to the caller; the enclave terminates with the supplied abend code.
semantics.condition: No condition or feedback token is associated with this service.
semantics.cleanUp: Preserve the caller's clean-up value; termination handlers, dumps and user exits depend on it and on the TERMTHDACT runtime option, which this profile does not infer.
semantics.target: Map to an abnormal process or job termination that carries the abend code; do not convert it into a recoverable exception that returns to the caller.

parameters.name: input_char_date
parameters.representation: VSTRING: halfword binary length followed by 5 to 255 date characters

parameters.name: picture_string
parameters.representation: VSTRING: halfword binary length followed by picture characters

semantics.calendar: Gregorian; valid dates are 15 October 1582 through 31 December 9999.
semantics.failureOutput: An invalid input date produces zero Lilian days and non-CEE000 feedback.
semantics.picture: Preserve the supplied picture language and documented leading/trailing character handling.
semantics.centuryWindow: Two-digit years depend on the runtime century window, configurable through CEESCEN. Do not silently substitute a target date library's default window.
semantics.compilerContext: COBOL intrinsic date arithmetic requires the original INTDATE setting; this profile does not infer it.

parameters.name: function
parameters.representation: 4-byte display call function, left-justified and blank-padded (for example GU, GN, GNP, ISRT)

parameters.name: db pcb
parameters.representation: database or GSAM PCB group item from the PSB passed on entry; IMS sets its status code and key feedback

parameters.name: i/o area
parameters.representation: segment I/O area large enough for the returned data

parameters.name: ssa
parameters.representation: optional display segment search arguments; up to 15 may follow the I/O area

semantics.interface: DL/I call through the IMS language interface (DFSLI000); the optional leading parmcount is not used by these call sites.
semantics.dataModel: Segment hierarchy, keys and GSAM datasets come from the estate's DBD and PSB sources (app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/ims); this contract does not infer them.
semantics.status: Each call's outcome is the PCB status code; blank means success, GE/GB mean not found / end of database. Preserve the caller's status checks.
semantics.target: Map to an implementation that preserves hierarchical GU/GN/GNP/ISRT positioning per PCB; do not reorder or batch calls.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.representation: fullword binary interval; STIMER BINTVL units of 0.01 second, high-order bit must be zero

semantics.control: Saves the caller's registers, issues STIMER WAIT,BINTVL for the supplied interval, restores registers, sets R15 to 0 and returns.
semantics.saveArea: Sets byte 12 of the caller's save area to X'FF' after restoring registers (the conventional 'returned' flag); no other caller storage changes.
semantics.limits: An interval above X'7FFFFFFF' abends X'12F' per STIMER; the routine does not validate the value.
semantics.target: Map to a blocking delay of interval/100 seconds that returns normally.

parameters.name: CODATECN-REC
parameters.representation: 80-byte record laid out by DSECT COCDATFT: type X(1), input date X(20), output type X(1), output date X(20), error message X(38)

semantics.type1: Input type '1' with output type other than '2': copies YYYYMMDD to output as YYYY-MM-DD (10 bytes).
semantics.type2: Input type '2' with output type other than '1': copies YYYY-MM-DD to output as YYYYMMDD (8 bytes).
semantics.error: Any other combination moves 38 bytes starting at literal 'INVALID INPUT' into the error message; bytes 14-38 come from the literal pool and are not determined by the source.
semantics.type1Guard: The type-1 dash check compares 20 bytes from input+4 with the 1-byte literal and following literal-pool bytes; its outcome is not determined by the source alone.
semantics.untouched: Output bytes beyond those written and the error message on success are left unchanged.
semantics.target: Port the documented conversions and flag the two literal-pool dependent behaviours for review rather than guessing them.

parameters.name: sqlca
parameters.representation: SQL communication area whose SQLCODE and tokens are formatted

parameters.name: message
parameters.representation: VARCHAR output area: leading halfword gives the remaining length (minimum 240); text lines of lrecl bytes follow

parameters.name: lrecl
parameters.representation: fullword binary logical record length of each output line, 72-240

semantics.interface: Db2-supplied assembler subroutine (SDSNSAMP) for CICS programs that need CICS storage handling; formats the SQLCA the same way as DSNTIAR.
semantics.callSite: COTRTLIC reaches it through CALL LIT-DSNTIAC (copybook CSDB2RPY), where LIT-DSNTIAC is a never-modified PIC X(7) VALUE 'DSNTIAC'.
semantics.quirk: CardDemo passes WS-DSNTIAC-LRECL as PIC S9(4) COMP (a halfword, VALUE +72) where the documented parameter is a fullword; on z/OS the routine reads the following two bytes too. Preserve the intended 72-byte line length and report the defect rather than reproducing storage overlap.
semantics.status: RETURN-CODE is set by the routine; the caller treats zero as success and otherwise reports 'DSNTIAC CD'.
semantics.target: Map to the target's SQL diagnostic text (for example SQLException message) split into lrecl-sized lines in the message area.
